title: Section 80CCD NPS Deductions
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India (Income Tax Act 1961 & Income Tax Act 2025)
reference: Section 80CCD(1B), Income Tax Act 1961 — recodified under Income Tax Act 2025
content: Section 80CCD relates to deductions for contributions made towards the National Pension System (NPS) or Atal Pension Yojana (APY). Section 80CCD(1) covers employee contributions towards NPS up to 10% of basic salary + DA, included within the overall ₹1,50,000 cap of Section 80C (recodified as Section 123 under the Income Tax Act 2025). Section 80CCD(1B) provides an ADDITIONAL tax deduction of up to ₹50,000 specifically for individual contributions to NPS Tier-I accounts. This ₹50,000 deduction is over and above the ₹1,50,000 limit specified under Section 80C (Section 123). Section 80CCD(2) covers employer contributions to employee NPS up to 10% of basic salary (14% for Central/State Government employees), which is deductible under both the Old Tax Regime and New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC / Section 202).
